name: ploaness-workspace
description: Workspace root for ploaness, the external quality harness for Payload CMS projects
author: Herman Ciechanowiec <herman@ciechanowiec.eu>

scripts.verify:fast: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:eslint && pnpm run test

typographyExclusions.reason: Vale detector definitions, whose content is the character they detect

javascriptAllowlist.reason: analyzer configuration, loaded as JavaScript by the tools that read it
package entry shims, loaded as JavaScript by the resolver
build scripts run by node directly, before any TypeScript is compiled
